name: lang-leak-checker
description: TypeScript terminal tool that scans HTML and flags every inner HTML element that is not in the user's chosen language — catching untranslated/English "language leakages" on a site in one pass. It is element-level, not word-level: slang, loanwords, and brand names inside an otherwise-Danish element pass by design (Nick's explicit requirement). Only an element that confidently reads as the wrong language is flagged.
author: NickTriez

scripts.test: npm pkg set scripts.test="node --test --import tsx test/"
